info.description: Global, site-wide settings. Every page falls back to these values when it doesn't set its own.

siteName.description: Used in the browser tab suffix and in structured data.

siteUrl.description: Public base URL, no trailing slash. Used to build canonical URLs and the sitemap.

logo.description: Header logo. Leave empty to keep the built-in /assets/logo.png.

favicon.description: Browser tab icon. Leave empty to keep the built-in default.

defaultSeoTitle.description: Fallback page title for any page that doesn't set its own.

defaultMetaDescription.default: Pixantra is a creative digital agency delivering web design, branding, motion and development for growing businesses.
defaultMetaDescription.description: Fallback Google snippet for any page that doesn't set its own.

themeColor.description: Browser UI colour on mobile. Hex, e.g. #0b63c4.

organizationEmail.description: Contact email published in the site's structured data.

ga4Id.description: Google Analytics 4 ID (G-XXXXXXX). Leave blank to not load Analytics at all.

gtmId.description: Google Tag Manager ID (GTM-XXXXXXX). Leave blank to not load GTM.

gscVerification.description: Google Search Console verification code (the content value only).

bingVerification.description: Bing Webmaster verification code (the content value only).

robotsTxt.description: Custom robots.txt, used verbatim. Leave blank to auto-generate a sensible default with the sitemap link.
